messages:
maria: quick prototype dropped for compact key list + single-key rotate/revoke microflows https://www.figma.com/file/NEW123 (see /compact-row). looking for fast feedback on copy, CTA defaults, and a11y for the inline undo.

lee: saw it. a11y: ensure the inline undo is keyboard-focusable and announced by aria-live=polite. tab order on the row should go: key name -> actions -> more menu.

adam: copy nit: in-row action says 'Rotate' vs modal says 'Rotate & Revoke'. suggest unify to 'Rotate (replace)' to hint at revocation. or show small helper text: 'Default: replace old key unless copy selected.'

anya: permission UX: if Bulk button disabled show 'Request access' inline link. opens small modal prefilled with selected keys + scope. reduces dead ends.

maria: good calls. also adding a small 'system' badge for high-risk keys and requiring type-to-confirm for them. will update Figma and ping when done.

ui-bot: Staging deploy queued: feature/keys-ux/compact-row -> staging (build 532).

lee: I'll run a quick keyboard pass on staging and report if anything fails.

maria: thanks team :raised_hands:
